result.reason: The redline satisfies the fallback: affiliates are covered without even requiring notice, and transfer is permitted to a successor in an M&A transaction. It also extends use to contractors and brokers acting for Client. It does not reach the preferred position because it provides no perpetual, irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, and the subscription remains subject to non-renewal and Section 13 triggers that are not limited to uncured material breach. The changes are targeted and preserve the underlying use restrictions, but the stacked conjunctions and the termination language’s poor alignment with Section 13 reduce drafting quality.
